```ts
/**
 * The walking skeleton in the browser (spec 11.5, 11.6 item 2; contract 5.5): arena and fromCsr uploads, `degree` on
 * karate / random1k / arcCount 0 against the oracle bitwise, the 17M-item fill on the 2D dispatch with the pinned checksum
 * (the SwiftShader / NVIDIA-Chromium leg of "bitwise across adapters"), one K3 + K4 exact-tile FA2 iteration on karate in
 * paper mode from host-written state against the f64 pair sum and the hand-computed controller, twice bitwise, and the
 * SwiftShader / NVIDIA-Chromium noise fixtures written through the commands bridge when GRAPHTY_NOISE_FLOOR_WRITE=1
 * (spec 11.9 item 3). Both CI browser adapters expose "subgroups" (SwiftShader size 4, NVIDIA 32), so the subgroup twin is
 * the form exercised here (spec 11.6 item 5; the workgroup twin is the compile matrix of P2).
 */

import { type GraphSnapshot } from "@graphty/graph-format";

import noiseFloorDoc from "../../benchmarks/results/noise-floor.json";
import { degree } from "../../src/algorithms/degree.js";
import {
    FA2_DISTANCE_FLOOR,
    FA2_DISTANCE_FLOOR_SQ,
    FA2_FLAG_FIRST,
    MAX_ITERATIONS_PER_STEP,
    PARTIAL_BYTES,
    STATE_HEADER_BYTES,
    TRACE_RECORD_BYTES,
    UNIFORM_SLOT_BYTES,
} from "../../src/constants.js";
import { type GpuContext } from "../../src/context.js";
import { BufferUsage } from "../../src/device/webgpu-constants.js";
import { plan1d } from "../../src/kernel/dispatch.js";
import { type UniformBlock, type UniformValues } from "../../src/kernel/struct-block.js";
import { FA2_PARAMS, FA2_STATE, FA2_TRACE, FILL_PARAMS, kernelSpec } from "../../src/kernels.js";
import { RepulsionExact } from "../../src/layouts/repulsion-exact.js";
import { prepareReduce, type ReduceScope } from "../../src/primitives/reduce.js";
import { type GpuCaps } from "../../src/types/context.js";
import { type Binding } from "../../src/types/memory.js";
import { csrSnapshotOf, fixture, KARATE_EDGES, snapshotOf } from "../helpers/graphs.js";
import { runKernel } from "../helpers/kernel.js";
import {
    LINEAR_ID_CHECKSUM,
    LINEAR_ID_ITEMS,
    LINEAR_ID_SAMPLES,
    LINEAR_ID_VALUE,
    linearIdChecksum,
} from "../helpers/linear-id.js";
import { expectAllClose, expectBitwiseEqual, flooredRelError } from "../helpers/matchers.js";
import { adapterClassBrowser, recordNoiseRowBrowser, writeNoiseFixtureBrowser } from "../helpers/noise-floor-browser.js";
import { outDegreeOracle } from "../oracle/degree.js";
import { reduceOracle } from "../oracle/reduce.js";
import { acquireBrowser, requireBrowserGpu } from "../setup/browser.js";

// ---- local buffer helpers (PLAN DECISION a: test/helpers/device.ts imports the Node setup and cannot be bundled here)

const STORAGE_USAGE = BufferUsage.STORAGE | BufferUsage.COPY_SRC | BufferUsage.COPY_DST;

/** A buffer of the given usage created straight on the device (destroyed by the test; never through the allocator). */
function createBuffer(ctx: GpuContext, byteLength: number, label: string, usage: number = STORAGE_USAGE): GPUBuffer {
    return ctx.device.createBuffer({ size: byteLength, usage, label });
}

/** A buffer holding `data` after one writeBuffer. */
function uploadArray(ctx: GpuContext, data: ArrayBufferView, label: string, usage: number = STORAGE_USAGE): GPUBuffer {
    const buffer = createBuffer(ctx, data.byteLength, label, usage);
    ctx.device.queue.writeBuffer(buffer, 0, data);
    return buffer;
}

/** The whole-buffer Binding. */
function whole(buffer: GPUBuffer): Binding {
    return { buffer, offset: 0, size: buffer.size, window: null };
}

/** A UNIFORM | COPY_DST buffer of one 256-byte slot holding a block's values at offset 0. */
function uniformBuffer(ctx: GpuContext, block: UniformBlock, values: UniformValues, label: string): GPUBuffer {
    const bytes = new ArrayBuffer(Math.max(block.byteLength, UNIFORM_SLOT_BYTES));
    block.write(new DataView(bytes), values);
    return uploadArray(ctx, new Uint8Array(bytes), label, BufferUsage.UNIFORM | BufferUsage.COPY_DST);
}

/** Reads `count` u32 words through the context's staging ring. */
async function readU32(ctx: GpuContext, buffer: GPUBuffer, count: number, byteOffset = 0): Promise<Uint32Array<ArrayBuffer>> {
    return new Uint32Array(await ctx.readback.read(buffer, count * 4, undefined, byteOffset));
}

/** Reads `count` f32 values through the context's staging ring. */
async function readF32(ctx: GpuContext, buffer: GPUBuffer, count: number, byteOffset = 0): Promise<Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>> {
    return new Float32Array(await ctx.readback.read(buffer, count * 4, undefined, byteOffset));
}

/** One scalar field of a block's read(). */
function scalar(values: UniformValues, name: string): number {
    const v = values[name];
    if (typeof v !== "number") {
        throw new Error(`field ${name} is not a scalar`);
    }
    return v;
}

/** The tolerance of a test id from the committed noise-floor file (PLAN DECISION e). */
function toleranceFor(id: string): number {
    const doc = noiseFloorDoc as unknown as {
        readonly tolerances: Readonly<Record<string, { readonly value: number; readonly basis: string } | undefined>>;
    };
    const entry = doc.tolerances[id];
    if (entry === undefined) {
        throw new Error(`benchmarks/results/noise-floor.json has no tolerance "${id}" (P1-T6 records it before this test runs)`);
    }
    return entry.value;
}

// ---- the reduce input (PLAN DECISION b: reconciled with test/primitives/reduce.test.ts in Step 31)

/** 1000 values in [0, 1) from a Knuth multiplicative hash of the index, f32-rounded, so the summation order matters. */
function reduceInputRandom1k(): Float32Array<ArrayBuffer> {
    const values = new Float32Array(1000);
    for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
        values[i] = (((i + 1) * 2654435761) % 4294967296) / 4294967296;
    }
    return values;
}

// ---- the FA2 skeleton reference (PLAN DECISION b: reconciled with test/layouts/skeleton.test.ts in Step 31)

/** The host-written inputs of one K3 + K4 iteration and their f64 reference. */
interface SkeletonReference {
    readonly n: number;
    readonly groups: number;
    /** xyz + mass per node (vec4f), f32. */
    readonly pos: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    /** The whole state buffer: the header (speed 1, speedEfficiency 1, the centroid) and a zeroed trace region. */
    readonly state: Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>;
    /** The Fa2Params record. */
    readonly params: UniformValues;
    /** The f64 pair sum + gravity, stride 3. */
    readonly force: Float64Array;
    /** swing, traction, speed, speedEfficiency after K4 (paper mode, oldForce 0, mask clear). */
    readonly trace: readonly [number, number, number, number];
}

/** The one-workgroup speed finalize of 4.5 (K4) in f64: returns [speed, speedEfficiency] after the iteration. */
function speedFinalize(swing: number, traction: number, n: number, speed0: number, eff0: number, jitterTolerance: number): [number, number] {
    const optJitter = 0.05 * Math.sqrt(n);
    const minJitter = Math.sqrt(optJitter);
    const maxJitter = 10;
    const tr = Math.max(traction, 1e-30);
    const other = Math.min(maxJitter, (optJitter * traction) / (n * n));
    let jitter = jitterTolerance * Math.max(minJitter, other);
    let eff = eff0;
    if (swing / tr > 2) {
        if (eff > 0.05) {
            eff *= 0.5;
        }
        jitter = Math.max(jitter, jitterTolerance);
    }
    const targetSpeed = swing === 0 ? 1e30 : (jitter * eff * traction) / swing;
    if (swing > jitter * traction) {
        if (eff > 0.05) {
            eff *= 0.7;
        }
    } else if (speed0 < 1000) {
        eff *= 1.3;
    }
    return [speed0 + Math.min(targetSpeed - speed0, 0.5 * speed0), eff];
}

/**
 * The inputs: node i at angle 2 pi i / n and radius 1 + 0.5 ((7 i) mod 11) / 11 in the xy plane, mass outDegree + 1,
 * centroid the f32-rounded mean; paper mode (SWING_MODE 0), gravity toward the centroid, scalingRatio 2, gravity 1,
 * jitterTolerance 1, speed / speedEfficiency 1, oldForce 0, fixed mask clear. No pair is closer than 0.18, so neither the
 * coincident kick nor the 0.01 floor fires. With these inputs the controller takes the branches: other = 10 -> jitter 10;
 * swing / traction = 2 exactly (per node tr = 0.5 sw, exact in both f32 and f64), so not > 2; targetSpeed 5; swing < 10 x
 * traction and speed < 1000 -> speedEfficiency 1.3; speed 1 + min(4, 0.5) = 1.5.
 */
function skeletonReference(s: GraphSnapshot, workgroupSize: number): SkeletonReference {
    const n = s.nodeCount;
    const outDeg = outDegreeOracle(s);
    const pos = new Float32Array(4 * n);
    let cx = 0;
    let cy = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const theta = (2 * Math.PI * i) / n;
        const r = 1 + (0.5 * ((7 * i) % 11)) / 11;
        pos[4 * i] = r * Math.cos(theta);
        pos[4 * i + 1] = r * Math.sin(theta);
        pos[4 * i + 2] = 0;
        pos[4 * i + 3] = outDeg[i] + 1;
        cx += pos[4 * i];
        cy += pos[4 * i + 1];
    }
    const centroid: [number, number, number] = [Math.fround(cx / n), Math.fround(cy / n), 0];
    const scalingRatio = 2;
    const gravity = 1;
    const force = new Float64Array(3 * n);
    let minPair = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const mi = pos[4 * i + 3];
        let fx = 0;
        let fy = 0;
        for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (j === i) {
                continue;
            }
            const dx = pos[4 * i] - pos[4 * j];
            const dy = pos[4 * i + 1] - pos[4 * j + 1];
            let d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            minPair = Math.min(minPair, Math.sqrt(d2));
            d2 = Math.max(d2, FA2_DISTANCE_FLOOR_SQ);
            const k = (scalingRatio * mi * pos[4 * j + 3]) / d2;
            fx += dx * k;
            fy += dy * k;
        }
        const qx = pos[4 * i] - centroid[0];
        const qy = pos[4 * i + 1] - centroid[1];
        const dq = Math.hypot(qx, qy);
        if (dq > FA2_DISTANCE_FLOOR) {
            fx += (-gravity * mi * qx) / dq;
            fy += (-gravity * mi * qy) / dq;
        }
        force[3 * i] = fx;
        force[3 * i + 1] = fy;
        force[3 * i + 2] = 0;
    }
    expect(minPair, "the inputs must stay clear of the coincident and floor regions").toBeGreaterThan(0.02);
    let swing = 0;
    let traction = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        const len = Math.hypot(force[3 * i], force[3 * i + 1], force[3 * i + 2]);
        swing += pos[4 * i + 3] * len;
        traction += 0.5 * pos[4 * i + 3] * len;
    }
    const [speed, eff] = speedFinalize(swing, traction, n, 1, 1, 1);
    const state = new Uint8Array(STATE_HEADER_BYTES + MAX_ITERATIONS_PER_STEP * TRACE_RECORD_BYTES);
    FA2_STATE.write(new DataView(state.buffer), { speed: 1, speedEfficiency: 1, centroid: [centroid[0], centroid[1], 0, 0] });
    const params: UniformValues = {
        n,
        dim: 2,
        flags: FA2_FLAG_FIRST,
        tierStart: 0,
        tierEnd: n,
        iterationIndex: 0,
        seed: 0,
        nearMax: 64,
        scalingRatio,
        gravity,
        jitterTolerance: 1,
        scale: 1,
        center: [0, 0, 0, 0],
        settleThreshold: 0.001,
        extentFactor: 6,
        gridMax: 0,
        levels: 0,
        pad: [0, 0, 0, 0],
    };
    return { n, groups: Math.ceil(n / workgroupSize), pos, state, params, force, trace: [swing, traction, speed, eff] };
}

// ---- the suite

describe("walking skeleton in the browser (spec 11.5, 11.6 item 2)", () => {
    it("uploads the arena and the fromCsr paths and runs degree on karate, random1k and arcCount 0 against the oracle bitwise", async (t) => {
        await requireBrowserGpu(t);
        const ctx = await acquireBrowser({ label: "skeleton/degree" });
        const cls = adapterClassBrowser(ctx.caps);
        console.warn(
            `[skeleton] adapter ${cls} subgroups ${ctx.caps.subgroupMinSize}/${ctx.caps.subgroupMaxSize} workgroup ${ctx.workgroupSize} software ${String(ctx.caps.software)}`,
        );
        expect(ctx.caps.features.has("subgroups"), "both CI browser adapters expose subgroups (spec 11.6 item 5)").toBe(true);
        expect(ctx.caps.subgroupMaxSize).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);

        const karate = snapshotOf(KARATE_EDGES, { label: "skeleton/karate" });
        const karateCsr = csrSnapshotOf(KARATE_EDGES, { label: "skeleton/karate-csr" });
        const random1k = fixture("random1k", 1).snapshot;
        const empty = snapshotOf([], { nodeCount: 5, label: "skeleton/empty-arcs" });
        try {
            expect(ctx.residency.core(karate).plan).toBe("arena");
            expect(karateCsr.arena).toBeNull();
            expect(ctx.residency.core(karateCsr).plan).toBe("perArray");
            const emptyCore = ctx.residency.core(empty);
            expect(emptyCore.colIdx).toBeNull();
            expect(emptyCore.weights).toBeNull();

            for (const s of [karate, karateCsr, random1k, empty]) {
                const first = await degree(ctx, s);
                const second = await degree(ctx, s);
                expectBitwiseEqual(first, second, `${s.label ?? "snapshot"} twice`);
                expectBitwiseEqual(first, outDegreeOracle(s), s.label ?? "snapshot");
                expect(first.length).toBe(s.nodeCount);
            }
            const random1kDegrees = await degree(ctx, random1k);
            const path = await writeNoiseFixtureBrowser("degree", "random1k", cls, random1kDegrees, "u32");
            if (path !== "") {
                console.warn(`[skeleton] wrote ${path}`);
            }
        } finally {
            for (const s of [karate, karateCsr, random1k, empty]) {
                ctx.release(s);
            }
        }
        expect(ctx.residency.stats().buffers, "release leaves no buffers (spec 11.6 item 7)").toBe(0);
        expect(ctx.residency.stats().snapshots).toBe(0);
        expect(ctx.pool.idleBytes).toBe(0);
    });

    it("fills the 17M-item map on the 2D dispatch: the sampled words equal i + value and the checksum is the pinned one", async (t) => {
        await requireBrowserGpu(t);
        const ctx = await acquireBrowser({ label: "skeleton/linear-id" });
        const cls = adapterClassBrowser(ctx.caps);
        const plan = plan1d(LINEAR_ID_ITEMS, ctx.workgroupSize, ctx.caps);
        expect(plan.y, "16,776,961 items need the 2D dispatch at WG 256 (spec 5.2)").toBeGreaterThan(1);
        expect(plan.items).toBe(LINEAR_ID_ITEMS);
        const dst = createBuffer(ctx, LINEAR_ID_ITEMS * 4, "skeleton/linear-id");
        try {
            const spec = kernelSpec("fill");
            const params = { block: FILL_PARAMS, values: { count: LINEAR_ID_ITEMS, value: LINEAR_ID_VALUE, mode: 1 } };
            await runKernel(ctx, spec, { dst: whole(dst) }, plan, params);
            const words = await readU32(ctx, dst, LINEAR_ID_ITEMS);
            expect(words.length).toBe(LINEAR_ID_ITEMS);
            const sampled: number[] = [];
            for (const i of LINEAR_ID_SAMPLES) {
                expect(words[i], `word ${i}`).toBe((i + LINEAR_ID_VALUE) % 4294967296);
                sampled.push(words[i]);
            }
            const checksum = linearIdChecksum(words);
            expect(checksum, "bitwise across adapters: the pinned checksum of test/helpers/linear-id.ts").toBe(LINEAR_ID_CHECKSUM);
            // twice bitwise on the boundary words (spec 11.9 item 4): a second fill of the same buffer
            await runKernel(ctx, spec, { dst: whole(dst) }, plan, params);
            const again = await readU32(ctx, dst, LINEAR_ID_ITEMS);
            expect(linearIdChecksum(again)).toBe(checksum);
            for (const i of LINEAR_ID_SAMPLES) {
                expect(again[i]).toBe(words[i]);
            }
            // PLAN DECISION d: the fixture stores the checksum and the sampled words, not 16.7M values
            await writeNoiseFixtureBrowser("fill", "linear-id", cls, [checksum, ...sampled], "u32");
        } finally {
            dst.destroy();
        }
    });

    it("reduces the random1k f32 sum through the subgroup twin against the f64 oracle and writes this adapter's fixture", async (t) => {
        await requireBrowserGpu(t);
        const ctx = await acquireBrowser({ label: "skeleton/reduce" });
        const cls = adapterClassBrowser(ctx.caps);
        const values = reduceInputRandom1k();
        const expected = reduceOracle(values, "sum", "f32");
        if (typeof expected !== "number") {
            throw new Error("a scalar sum");
        }
        const scratch: GPUBuffer[] = [];
        const uniforms: GPUBuffer[] = [];
        const scope: ReduceScope = {
            device: ctx.device,
            caps: ctx.caps,
            pipelines: ctx.pipelines,
            pool: ctx.pool,
            workgroupSize: ctx.workgroupSize,
            scratch: (byteLength, label) => {
                const buffer = ctx.pool.acquire(byteLength, STORAGE_USAGE, label);
                scratch.push(buffer);
                return buffer;
            },
            params: (block, blockValues) => {
                const buffer = uniformBuffer(ctx, block, blockValues, "skeleton/reduce-params");
                uniforms.push(buffer);
                return { binding: { buffer, offset: 0, size: block.byteLength, window: null }, offset: 0 };
            },
        };
        const src = uploadArray(ctx, values, "skeleton/reduce-src");
        const out = uploadArray(ctx, new Uint32Array(4), "skeleton/reduce-out");
        try {
            const planner = await prepareReduce(scope, "sum", "f32");
            const sums: number[] = [];
            for (let run = 0; run < 2; run++) {
                const encoder = ctx.device.createCommandEncoder({ label: `skeleton/reduce-${run}` });
                const pass = encoder.beginComputePass({ label: "skeleton/reduce" });
                planner.record(pass, whole(src), values.length, whole(out), 0);
                pass.end();
                ctx.device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
                expect(planner.lastDispatches).toBe(2);
                sums.push((await readF32(ctx, out, 1))[0]);
            }
            expect(Object.is(sums[0], sums[1]), "twice bitwise").toBe(true);
            const tolerance = values.length * 2 ** -24 * Math.abs(expected);
            expect(Math.abs(sums[0] - expected), `f32 sum ${sums[0]} vs f64 ${expected}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(tolerance);
            await writeNoiseFixtureBrowser("reduce", "random1k", cls, [sums[0]], "f32");
        } finally {
            src.destroy();
            out.destroy();
            for (const buffer of scratch) {
                ctx.pool.release(buffer);
            }
            for (const buffer of uniforms) {
                buffer.destroy();
            }
        }
    });

    it("runs one K3 + K4 exact-tile iteration on karate (paper mode) from host-written state: force vs the f64 pair sum and the trace vs the hand-computed controller, twice bitwise", async (t) => {
        await requireBrowserGpu(t);
        const ctx = await acquireBrowser({ label: "skeleton/fa2" });
        const cls = adapterClassBrowser(ctx.caps);
        const tolerance = toleranceFor("fa2-skeleton.force");
        const s = snapshotOf(KARATE_EDGES, { label: "skeleton/fa2-karate" });
        const ref = skeletonReference(s, ctx.workgroupSize);
        // the reference reproduces the pinned hand-computed numbers of this input rule (re-derive them when Step 31 changes the rule)
        expect(Math.abs(ref.trace[0] - 294691.6959661952) / 294691.6959661952).toBeLessThan(1e-9);
        expect(Math.abs(ref.trace[1] - 147345.8479830976) / 147345.8479830976).toBeLessThan(1e-9);
        expect(ref.trace[2]).toBe(1.5);
        expect(ref.trace[3]).toBeCloseTo(1.3, 12);

        const { n } = ref;
        const pos = uploadArray(ctx, ref.pos, "skeleton/fa2-pos");
        const state = uploadArray(ctx, ref.state, "skeleton/fa2-state");
        const force = uploadArray(ctx, new Float32Array(3 * n), "skeleton/fa2-force");
        const oldForce = uploadArray(ctx, new Float32Array(3 * n), "skeleton/fa2-oldForce");
        const fixedMask = uploadArray(ctx, new Uint32Array(Math.ceil(n / 32)), "skeleton/fa2-fixedMask");
        const partials = uploadArray(ctx, new Uint8Array(ref.groups * PARTIAL_BYTES), "skeleton/fa2-partials");
        const params = uniformBuffer(ctx, FA2_PARAMS, ref.params, "skeleton/fa2-params");
        const buffers = [pos, state, force, oldForce, fixedMask, partials, params];
        try {
            const stage = await RepulsionExact.create(ctx.pipelines, ctx.caps, { SWING_MODE: 0, STRONG_GRAVITY: false, GRAVITY_CENTER: 0 });
            stage.bind({
                pos: whole(pos),
                state: { buffer: state, offset: 0, size: STATE_HEADER_BYTES, window: null },
                trace: { buffer: state, offset: STATE_HEADER_BYTES, size: MAX_ITERATIONS_PER_STEP * TRACE_RECORD_BYTES, window: null },
                force: whole(force),
                oldForce: whole(oldForce),
                fixedMask: whole(fixedMask),
                partials: whole(partials),
                params: { buffer: params, offset: 0, size: FA2_PARAMS.byteLength, window: null },
            });

            const iterate = async (): Promise<{ force: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer>; trace: Float32Array<ArrayBuffer> }> => {
                // the same host-written start for every run: K3 accumulates into force, K4 reads the header
                ctx.device.queue.writeBuffer(state, 0, ref.state);
                ctx.device.queue.writeBuffer(force, 0, new Float32Array(3 * n));
                const encoder = ctx.device.createCommandEncoder({ label: "skeleton/fa2" });
                const pass = encoder.beginComputePass({ label: "skeleton/fa2" });
                stage.record(pass, n, 0);
                pass.end();
                ctx.device.queue.submit([encoder.finish()]);
                const f = await readF32(ctx, force, 3 * n);
                const traceBytes = await ctx.readback.read(state, TRACE_RECORD_BYTES, undefined, STATE_HEADER_BYTES);
                const record = FA2_TRACE.read(new DataView(traceBytes));
                const header = FA2_STATE.read(new DataView(await ctx.readback.read(state, STATE_HEADER_BYTES)));
                expect(scalar(header, "speed")).toBe(scalar(record, "speed"));
                expect(scalar(header, "speedEfficiency")).toBe(scalar(record, "speedEfficiency"));
                return {
                    force: f,
                    trace: new Float32Array([
                        scalar(record, "swing"),
                        scalar(record, "traction"),
                        scalar(record, "speed"),
                        scalar(record, "speedEfficiency"),
                    ]),
                };
            };

            const first = await iterate();
            const second = await iterate();
            expectBitwiseEqual(first.force, second.force, "K3 force twice");
            expectBitwiseEqual(first.trace, second.trace, "K4 trace twice");

            // PLAN DECISION c: per-node vector relative error with the 11.4 floored denominator; its maximum is this
            // adapter's oracle-f64 noise row
            const err = flooredRelError(first.force, ref.force, 1e-3);
            let maxAbs = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < 3 * n; i++) {
                maxAbs = Math.max(maxAbs, Math.abs(first.force[i] - ref.force[i]));
            }
            expect(err.max, `K3 force vs the f64 pair sum: worst node ${err.argmax}, rel ${err.max}`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(tolerance);
            expectAllClose(first.trace, ref.trace, { rel: tolerance, abs: 1e-6 }, "K4 trace vs the hand-computed controller");
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                expect(first.force[3 * i + 2] === 0, `z of node ${i} in 2D (got ${first.force[3 * i + 2]})`).toBe(true);
            }

            await recordNoiseRowBrowser({
                id: `fa2-skeleton.force.oracle-f64.${cls}`,
                kernel: "fa2-repulsion-exact",
                fixture: "karate",
                comparison: "oracle-f64",
                a: cls,
                b: "oracle-f64",
                maxRelError: err.max,
                maxAbsError: maxAbs,
                samples: 3 * n,
            });
            await writeNoiseFixtureBrowser("fa2-repulsion-exact", "karate", cls, first.force, "f32");
            await writeNoiseFixtureBrowser("fa2-speed-finalize", "karate", cls, first.trace, "f32");
        } finally {
            for (const buffer of buffers) {
                buffer.destroy();
            }
            ctx.release(s);
        }
        expect(ctx.residency.stats().buffers).toBe(0);
    });

    it("adapterClassBrowser equals the Node adapterClass form on a faked GpuCaps", () => {
        const fake = {
            limits: {} as GPUSupportedLimits,
            features: new Set<string>(),
            wgslFeatures: new Set<string>(),
            subgroupMinSize: 32,
            subgroupMaxSize: 32,
            software: false,
            runtime: "browser",
            vendor: "nvidia",
            architecture: "ada-lovelace",
            device: "",
            description: "NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER",
        } satisfies GpuCaps;
        expect(adapterClassBrowser(fake)).toBe("nvidia-ada-lovelace-browser");
        expect(adapterClassBrowser({ ...fake, runtime: "node", vendor: "mesa", architecture: "software" })).toBe("mesa-software-node");
        expect(adapterClassBrowser({ ...fake, vendor: "google", architecture: "swiftshader" })).toBe("google-swiftshader-browser");
    });
});
```

````markdown
### The `degree` diagnostic

`degree(ctx, snapshot)` is the walking-skeleton kernel kept public as a diagnostic: it runs the row-walking gather with the
package's dummy-binding pattern and returns a `Uint32Array` equal to `snapshot.outDegree()`. If it disagrees, nothing else
will work; if it agrees, the device, the upload path, the pipeline cache and the readback ring all do.

```ts
import { fromEdgeArrays } from "@graphty/graph-format";
import { degree } from "@graphty/webgpu-graph-algorithms";
import { createNodeGpuContext } from "@graphty/webgpu-graph-algorithms/node";

const ctx = await createNodeGpuContext(); // Dawn through the webgpu package; { adapter: "llvmpipe" } selects the software adapter
const s = fromEdgeArrays({ directed: false, nodeCount: 3, src: new Uint32Array([0, 1]), dst: new Uint32Array([1, 2]) });
const out = await degree(ctx, s); // Uint32Array [1, 2, 1] === s.outDegree()
ctx.release(s); // destroys the snapshot's buffers (nothing is freed by GC)
ctx.dispose(); // destroys the device and lets the process exit
```

In a browser, `import { requestGpuContext } from "@graphty/webgpu-graph-algorithms/browser"` and `const ctx = await
requestGpuContext();` replace the first import and line; the rest is identical. Probe first when the app must degrade:
`const probe = await probeBrowserWebGpu(); if (!probe.ok) { /* probe.code is E_NO_WEBGPU, E_NO_ADAPTER or E_SOFTWARE_ONLY */ }`.

## Benchmarks

```bash
pnpm run bench                                    # every group; appends to benchmarks/out/<runner-class>.json
pnpm exec tsx benchmarks/run.ts upload roundtrip  # selected groups; --no-save, --runs N, --allow-software
pnpm run gpu:report > gpu-report.json             # the adapter report with a 10 s nvidia-smi sample
pnpm run bench:compare                            # the last out session vs benchmarks/results/<runner-class>.json (> 3x fails)
```

The runner class is `<vendor>-<architecture>-driver<major>` (`scripts/runner-class.js`; `GRAPHTY_RUNNER_CLASS` overrides it,
which the GPU lane sets to `gpu-linux-t4`). Software adapters never time anything: `pnpm run bench` prints
`software adapter: nothing timed` on lavapipe unless `--allow-software` is given, and a software session is never a
baseline. The checked-in baselines under `benchmarks/results/` are written by the owner on the dev box (the RTX 4070 SUPER)
and, for the GPU lane, from the lane's own artifact; `bench:compare` skips when the card was not quiet during the report's
sample. Groups at P1: `upload` (T-1), `roundtrip` (T-2, T-3).

| Id | What | Target | Measured (nvidia-ada-lovelace-driver580, median of 5) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T-1 | Upload of the 100k / 1M weighted hot prefix (16.4 MB); 1M / 10M (164 MB) | <= 10 ms; <= 100 ms | <ms>; <ms> |
| T-2 | `degree` + 400 KB readback at 100k (core resident), Node | <= 2 ms | <ms> |
| T-3 | Empty submit + 4-byte `readU32` round trip, Dawn | <= 0.1 ms | <ms> |
````

- [ ] **Step 40: Draft the commit script for the owner**

Create `/home/apowers/Projects/webgpu-graph-algorithms/tmp/commit-p1.sh` (modelled on `tmp/commit-initial.sh`: `set -euo pipefail`, `--dry-run`, sanity checks, `GPG_TTY`, one explicit `git add` and heredoc message per commit through `git commit -F -`, hooks narrowed with `-c core.hooksPath`, a "Next:" epilogue; NO trailers of any kind; never run by the task's author -- the pathspecs are verified with `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard` instead):

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Phase P1 (the walking skeleton) of webgpu-graph-algorithms as three commits:
# the integration unit (device layer, context, memory, kernel infrastructure:
# P1-T1 / T2 / T3), the kernels and the skeleton (registry, WGSL bodies, degree,
# reduce, the FA2 K3 + K4 stage, oracles, sabotage, the noise set: T4 / T5 / T6),
# and the gate work (leak counter, benchmarks, browser skeleton, bench-compare,
# the G1 record: T7).
#
#   bash tmp/commit-p1.sh            # stage and make three commits
#   bash tmp/commit-p1.sh --dry-run  # stage the first group and show what would happen
#
# The only prompt is the signing passphrase, once per commit. Hooks: none of
# this repository's own; the commits run with an empty hooks directory and
# HUSKY=0 exactly as tmp/commit-initial.sh did.

set -euo pipefail

REPO="/home/apowers/Projects/webgpu-graph-algorithms"
PKG="packages/webgpu-graph-algorithms"
HOOKS="$REPO/tmp/githooks"
DRY_RUN=0
[ "${1:-}" = "--dry-run" ] && DRY_RUN=1

cd "$REPO"

setup_hooks() { mkdir -p "$HOOKS"; }
cleanup_hooks() { rm -rf "$HOOKS"; }
trap cleanup_hooks EXIT
export HUSKY=0
if tty -s; then export GPG_TTY="$(tty)"; fi

commit_with() {
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
    echo "    dry run: not committing"
    return 0
  fi
  setup_hooks
  echo "    committing. You will be asked for your signing passphrase."
  git -c core.hooksPath="$HOOKS" commit -F -
  cleanup_hooks
  echo "    $(git log -1 --format='%h %G? %s')"
}

staged_is_empty() { git diff --cached --quiet; }

# add_all PATH... -- every path must exist (a missing P1 file is an error, not a skip)
add_all() {
  for p in "$@"; do
    [ -e "$p" ] || { echo "ERROR: expected $p to exist"; exit 1; }
  done
  git add -- "$@"
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity checks.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo "==> Checking the working tree"
git rev-parse --verify --quiet HEAD >/dev/null || { echo "ERROR: no HEAD; run tmp/commit-initial.sh and the P0 script first"; exit 1; }
[ "$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)" = "master" ] || { echo "ERROR: expected master, got $(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD)"; exit 1; }
git diff --cached --quiet || { echo "ERROR: something is already staged; unstage first: git reset"; exit 1; }
for p in tmp .env dist node_modules "$PKG/benchmarks/out" "$PKG/gpu-report.json" "$PKG/browser-results.json" "$PKG/coverage"; do
  git check-ignore -q "$p" || { echo "ERROR: $p is not ignored"; exit 1; }
done
if [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -E '(^|/)\.git/' | head -1)" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: an untracked path contains a .git directory"; exit 1
fi
# no non-ASCII byte anywhere in the package (the house rule; every P1 source, test, doc and fixture)
if grep -rlP '[^\x00-\x7F]' "$PKG/src" "$PKG/test" "$PKG/benchmarks" "$PKG/scripts" "$PKG/docs/decisions" "$PKG/README.md" "$PKG/CLAUDE.md" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '\.gsnp$' | head -1 | grep -q .; then
  echo "ERROR: non-ASCII bytes in:"; grep -rlP '[^\x00-\x7F]' "$PKG/src" "$PKG/test" "$PKG/benchmarks" "$PKG/scripts" "$PKG/docs/decisions" "$PKG/README.md" "$PKG/CLAUDE.md" | grep -v '\.gsnp$'; exit 1
fi
echo "    master, clean index, ignores in place, ASCII only"

# ===========================================================================
# COMMIT 1 -- the integration unit (P1-T1, P1-T2, P1-T3)
# ===========================================================================
echo
echo "==> 1/3  device layer, context, memory and kernel infrastructure"
add_all \
  "$PKG/src/context.ts" \
  "$PKG/src/device/acquire.ts" "$PKG/src/device/caps.ts" "$PKG/src/device/error-scope.ts" "$PKG/src/device/lost.ts" \
  "$PKG/src/types/context.ts" "$PKG/src/types/run.ts" "$PKG/src/types/memory.ts" \
  "$PKG/src/kernel/profiler.ts" "$PKG/src/browser/index.ts" "$PKG/src/node/index.ts" \
  "$PKG/src/memory/upload-plan.ts" "$PKG/src/memory/residency.ts" "$PKG/src/memory/buffer-pool.ts" "$PKG/src/memory/readback.ts" \
```
